title: Where's Waldo? Substrate Compositing, the Hidden Figure Protocol, and a Memographic Audit of the Search Ritual — New Human 2
creator: Lee Sharks; editor Johannes Sigil
description:
A *New Human 2* memographic artifact authored and prompted by Lee Sharks, edited by Johannes Sigil, and generated visually through ChatGPT / LABOR. The image combines a Boschean dense-garden idiom with the hidden-figure search protocol associated with *Where’s Waldo?*, asking whether the two traditions can coexist in one generated field without cancellation.

The companion analysis treats the result as substrate compositing: a generative model combines high art, popular visual culture, and meme logic without respecting inherited aesthetic hierarchy. It then links visual search to retrieval: Waldo hidden in a dense image becomes an analogy for an entity present but difficult to surface in a knowledge system. Platform-suppression claims remain attributed to the record and its cited captures.
